scope: Partial genuine ordinary-world seal own-slot/other-slot checkpoint, not TAC-10 acceptance
actualReview:
**No concrete blocker found in this ordinary-world seal checkpoint.** The two genuine branches satisfy the specific own-slot/other-slot Action witness requirement. This is **not TAC-10 acceptance**.

The implementation and retained records agree on the governing behavior:

- Both tears spend the companion’s actual scheduled Action, recording post-recovery interval50 and an ordinary **rupture +6 seconds** deadline. Tearing advances neither clock nor RNG.
- Paid encounter entry preserves that historical rupture and deadline. The own-slot branch carries its spent Action into entry. In the other-slot branch, the companion legitimately reaches old-calendar Start53 before entry and refreshes there; entry does not supply that refresh.
- The own-slot deadline remains **172039**, although the next retained command checkpoint observes expiration at **172040.5**. Source inspection confirms advancement visits the intermediate deadline. The other-slot branch observes expiration exactly at **172042.5**.
- Physical destruction persists after suppression expires. The physical view remains limited to its five fields; the source and driver preserve nonmutating queries and prevent another rupture.

The actual **20ft walking speed →1.5-second final edge** calculation is correct. Both earlier driver failures remain identifiable failures and contribute no passing execution. These findings are consistent with the [committed checkpoint](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/f4140a16fae39864af2d6b6bc33fe29494973eeb/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac10-ferry-wraith-runtime/WORLD_SEAL_CHECKPOINT.md).

I independently:

- Rehashed the archive and **all41 members**.
- Matched the r344 input to the preceding provenance archive, the executed driver to its commit, **468 compilation-input hashes** to frozen source, and the **three loaded runtime DLLs** to the retained seal build.
- Reconciled all16 command records and eight byte-identical save/restore pairs.
- Independently extracted save checksums, headers, actors, receipts, clocks and RNG values, confirming the unchanged344-receipt prefix and each branch’s subsequent records.
- Inspected Action ownership, admission carry, expiry ordering, persistence and public filtering, with a separate read-only source review.

**I did not compile, execute C#/PowerShell, restore saves through the engine, or run causal replay.** Those executions remain Codex’s retained evidence. The independent binary extraction was limited to the fields listed above.

Continue the already-approved TAC-10 qualification. The remaining ability/recharge, combat-interaction, boundary/privacy/forgery, consumer, full-regression, five-path and compatibility gates remain mandatory before final review. Main r462 still has **3RP**; the4RP successor example remains unfunded. No successor is authorized; Unity remains deferred and storage/Support remain held.
